articles.summary: When SPX Cooling Technologies engineers began their quest to design a new counterflow cooling tower, they were challenged to reach new heights in cooling performance. Equally important was their mission to create a solution that would greatly simplify and speed factory fabrication, delivery and field assembly. The result is the Marley® MD Everest,™ a cooling tower that has unparalleled customer advantages. The MD Everest’s unique design utilizes preassembled modules with fewer components, delivers to the jobsite up to 60% sooner and installs up to 80% faster than field-erected cooling towers.
articles.title: Marley MD Everest – HVAC Applications
